scope: FIELD INDEX route projections over showcase-manifest local routes
purpose: Make route identity, projection, operation, navigation and return behave the same regardless of which FIELD reading selected the route.
invariants: Exactly one manifest route is the focused object at a time.
AXIAL, LATEST, HEADS, MAP and OPEN PORTS are projections over that same route identity, not competing stores.
Changing a projection changes reading context, not route identity.
First activation of a different local route focuses it and writes the focus address into FIELD re-entry state.
Activating the already-focused same-origin local route may OPEN that route.
INSPECT, AXIAL and LENS operate on the focused route without silently changing canonical route identity.
Consequential or outbound actions remain behind their explicit action boundary; repeat-click navigation never grants send/actuate authority.
RETURN or browser re-entry must restore the invoking FIELD route identity when the caller state is available.

affordance.local_route: first click = FOCUS; focused click = OPEN

verification: browser smoke: LENS STACK → Studio → RETURN
existing mobile Lens RETURN and route/static validators
non_claims: Repeat-click OPEN is not permission to perform consequential external actions.
A projection being reachable does not make it useful or preferred.
This law does not merge AXIAL, APERTURE, Lens or DOCS into one interface.
